name: 0. Baseline operations
description: Steady demand and healthy supply. Reference point for comparison.

name: 1. Demand Surge
description: Azithromycin demand climbs sharply over three weeks, threatening a stockout.

name: 2. Supplier Disruption
description: Bharat Drugs delays Azithromycin PO-8841 by 16 days and cuts capacity.

name: 3. Expiry Risk
description: Azithromycin demand falls while lot L-AZI-101 nears expiry; FEFO limits wastage.

name: 4. Quality Rejection
description: Lot L-AZI-102 is rejected after use; downstream batches are traced.

name: 5. Combined Disruption
description: Surge, supplier delay and a rejected lot together, under a tight budget.

name: 6. Lumpy Demand Burst
description: Doxycycline sells in outbreak bursts with many zero days; a fresh burst hits while stock is thin.
